blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generative models can now synthesize highly realistic images, simultaneously increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery. Therefore, detecting AI-generated images becomes more essential, and a reliable detector must generalize to unseen generators and stay robust to unseen perturbations in the wild. Existing detectors are typically trained on either independently collected real and generated images or aligned real-generated pairs designed to mitigate content bias. Building on aligned pairs, recent methods form a mixed view by replacing some patches of the real image with their generated counterparts. However, we find that self-attention lets real and generated patches interact, so the feature of each patch no longer reflects its own source alone. This contextual shift makes a per-patch source label an imprecise target. To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL). Instead of labeling each patch, PRL compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between the views. (i) To give precise supervision under the contextual shift, a relative response objective measures the responses of source-changed patches against those of source-unchanged patches, which respond to the shift alone. (ii) To provide a reliable reference for the shift, a reference coherence objective keeps each group of source-unchanged patches moving as a whole. (iii) Since the two views contain different amounts of generated content, an area ranking objective asks the view with the larger generated area to have a higher mean patch score. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of PRL, which surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy across eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generative models nowadays can produce highly realistic images ( Karras et al., 2019 ; Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2026b ) , expanding the possibilities for visual content creation ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) while increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery ( Feuerriegel et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Nightingale and Farid, 2022 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . These concerns motivate AI-generated image detection, which aims to distinguish AI-generated images from real ones ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Frank et al., 2020 ; Chai et al., 2020 ; Ojha et al., 2023 ) . The task has two central challenges. The first is generalization : detectors are trained on a limited set of generators but must recognize images from unseen models ( Corvi et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ) . The second is robustness : images in the wild are resized, compressed and re-shared online, and a detector must remain effective after such post-processing ( Grommelt et al., 2024 ; Cozzolino et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2025a ; Cavia et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 现在的基因模型可以产生非常现实的图像(Karras等,2019年;Dhariwal和Nichol等,2021年;Rombach等,2022年;Esser等,2024年;Lu等,2023年;Li等,2026年b),扩大了视觉内容创造的可能性(OpenAI,2025年;黑森林实验室等,2025年;Wu等,2025年),同时增加了错误信息和视觉伪造的风险(Feuerriegel等,2023年;Chen等,2025年b;Nightingale和Farid,2025年b), 2022; 杨等, 2024. ). 这些关切激励AI生成的图像检测,旨在区分AI生成的图像与真实的图像(Wang等,2020;Frank等,2020;Chai等,2020;Ojha等,2023)。 这项任务有两个中心挑战。 首先是概括:探测器在有限的发电机组上接受训练,但必须识别来自未见模型的图像(Corvi等,2023;Zhu等,2023)。 第二是坚固性 : 野外的图像被调整大小,压缩并在网上重新共享,这种后处理后,探测器必须保持有效(Grommelt等,2024;Cozzolino等,2024;Yan等,2025a;Cavia等,2024).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Three training paradigms and the contextual shift. (a) Detectors built on hand-crafted features or on vision foundation models (VFMs) learn from real and generated images collected separately. (b) Alignment-based methods pair each real image with a reconstruction of matched content, but treat the two as independent training samples with their own image-level labels; the pair itself is not used by the supervision. (c) Patch-level methods replace some patches of a real image by their reconstruction and label each patch by its own source, in addition to the image-level label. (d) Contextual shift: a real patch q q has the same input in the real image and in a mixed view, yet its score rises once other patches are replaced, while the per-patch label of (c) still marks q q as real.
blocks.zh: 图1:三种培训模式和背景变化。 (a) 利用手工制作的地物或视基模型(VFM)制作的探测器,从分别收集的真实和生成的图像中学习。 (b) 基于对齐的方法将每个真实的图像与匹配内容的重建相配对,但将两者作为独立的培训样本,并带有自己的图像级别标签;对偶本身不为监督使用。 (c) 补丁级方法,除了图象级标签外,还用其重建来取代一些真实图像的补丁并用自己的来源给每个补丁贴上标签。 (d) 上下文转换:真实的补丁 q q在真实图像和混合视图中都有相同的输入,然而,一旦更换了其他补丁,它的分数会上升,而(c)的每平分标签仍然将q q标记为真实.

blocks.en: To meet these challenges, detectors have relied on hand-crafted features that expose the traces of generation, such as frequency spectra and pixel-level residuals ( Frank et al., 2020 ; Tan et al., 2024b ; Li et al., 2025 ) , or on the pretrained representations of vision foundation models (VFMs) ( Ojha et al., 2023 ; Koutlis and Papadopoulos, 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2025b ) . In either case, the training data are real and generated images collected separately (Figure 1 a). Such unaligned data differ in content, format and resolution as well as in source, and these differences offer a detector shortcuts around the traces of generation ( Guillaro et al., 2025 ; Rajan et al., 2025 ) . Alignment-based methods mitigate content bias by pairing each real image with a reconstruction of matched content, and detectors trained on such pairs generalize better ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Rajan et al., 2025 ; Guillaro et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) (Figure 1 b). Yet the alignment only shapes the data. The two images are still trained as independent samples with image-level labels, and their correspondence is never used as supervision. Recent methods go a step further on the aligned pair. PPL ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , for example, replaces some patches of a real image with their reconstruction, forming a mixed view in which the source of every patch is known, and supervises each patch by its own source (Figure 1 c).
blocks.zh: 为应对这些挑战,探测器依靠手工制作的能暴露出生成痕迹的特征,如频谱和像素水平残基(Frank等,2020年;Tan等,2024b;Li等,2025年),或视基模型(VFMs)经过预先训练的表示(Ojha等,2023年;Koutlis和帕帕佐普洛斯,2024年;Liu等,2025年). 2024; Yan等, 2025b.). 在这两种情况下,培训数据都是真实的,生成了单独收集的图像(图1a)。 这种不相通的数据在内容、格式和分辨率以及来源方面各不相同,这些差异提供了围绕生成痕迹的探测器捷径(Guillaro等,2025;Rajan等,2025)。 基于对齐的方法通过将每个真实图像与匹配内容的再生配对来减少内容偏差,并且对这种对等的探测器进行更好的归纳(Chen等,2024;Rajan等,2025;Guillaro等,2025;Chen等,2025a)(图1b)。 然而,调整只塑造数据。 这两幅相片仍被训练为带有相片级别标签的独立标本,而其对应的相片从未被用做监督. 最近的方法在对齐对齐方面更进一步。 例如,PPL(Yang等,2026年),用重建来代替一些真实图像的补丁,形成一个混合视图,其中已知每个补丁的来源,并用自己的来源来监督每个补丁(图1c).

blocks.en: However, such a per-patch label is an imprecise target. In a vision transformer, self-attention lets every token gather evidence from the whole view. In a mixed view, the traces of generation in the replaced patches therefore spread into the real ones, and the real patches in turn dilute the replaced ones, so the feature of a patch moves with its context although the patch itself does not. We call this contextual shift (Figure 1 d). The feature of a patch thus has two parts: the trace of its own source and the shift caused by the other patches, and a label that names only the source cannot tell them apart. It pushes the whole feature toward one class, so the supervision meant for the local trace is mixed with a context term, which Figure 2 makes visible in trained detectors. The label is exact about where the generated patches are, but it says nothing about what the feature of a patch should be once the rest of the view has changed.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种每幅标签是一个不准确的目标。 在视觉变压器中,自觉让每个符物都从全景收集出证据. 在混合观点中,被替换的补丁中的生成痕迹因此被扩散到真实的补丁中去,而真实的补丁反过来会稀释被替换的补丁,因此一个补丁的特征随上下文而移动,尽管补丁本身并不如此. 我们称之为背景转变(图1d)。 因此一个补丁的特征有两个部分: 其自来源的痕量和由其他补丁所引发的转移,以及一个只命名出源的标签无法将它们区分开来. 它将整个特征推向一个类,因此用于局部痕量的监管与上下文词相混合,图2可见于训练有素的探测器. 标签精确地说明了所生成的补丁的位置,但并没有说一旦其他视图发生变化,补丁的特征应该是什么.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Contextual shift in trained detectors. Each mixed input takes the outlined square from the aligned reconstruction and the rest from the real image. The maps show how much each patch score changes from the real image to the mixed input, darker for a larger change. For DINOv3 and PPL, we train a patch head on them. Although only the square changed, the DINOv3 detector and PPL respond outside it almost as much as inside it. PRL keeps a shift outside the square and responds inside it.
blocks.zh: 图 2:经过培训的探测器的背景变化。 每个混合输入都取自对齐重建的平方,其余取自真实图像. 地图显示每个补丁分数从真实图像到混合输入的改变多少,对于更大的变化来说更暗. 对DINOv3和PPL, 我们训练一个补丁头在他们身上。 虽然只有正方形变了,但DINov3探测器和PPL在其外的响应几乎和其内部一样多. PRL在正方形外保持一班并在里面响应.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL), which supervises responses instead of labels. From each aligned pair, we build two mixed views that differ in which patches are replaced (Figure 3 ), so that every patch has aligned content in both views and only its source may differ. A linear head maps the feature of each patch to a score, higher for stronger evidence of generation, and the change of this score between the two views is its patch response . For a patch whose source is the same in both views, the input is identical, so the response is the contextual shift alone; for a patch whose source differs, the response adds the effect of its own change. The same-source patches thus serve as references for the source-changed ones. PRL has three objectives. (i) Relative response supervises each source-changed group relative to its reference, which subtracts the shift and leaves a precise target. (ii) Reference coherence keeps each reference group moving as a whole, which makes it a stable and reliable reference. (iii) Area ranking asks the view with the larger generated area to score higher. Experiments validate this design. Supervising the fine-grained correspondence within aligned pairs while accounting for the contextual shift improves the detector on both fronts. PRL averages 96.40% balanced accuracy on eight standard benchmarks of diverse generators and 93.74% on three in-the-wild benchmarks, surpassing the best previous method by 4.3% and 5.9%, respectively. Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提议开展相对补丁反应学习(PRL),监督答复而不是标签。 从每个对齐的对齐中,我们构建出两个不同的混合观点,其中补丁被替换(图3),这样,每个补丁在两个视图中都有了对齐的内容,只有它的出处可能有所不同. 一个线性头部将每个补丁的特征映射到一个分数,更高,用于更强的生成证据,在两种观点之间改变这个分数是它的补丁响应. . 对于两个视图中来源相同的补丁来说,输入是相同的,因此单是响应是上下文的转变;对于来源不同的补丁,响应会增加自身变化的效果. 因此,同一来源的补丁可作为变更源的参考。 PRL有三个目标. (一)相对响应监督每个源变化组相对于其参考文献,该参考文献减去了移位并留下了精确的目标. (二) 参考一致性使每个参考组保持整体运动,使其成为一个稳定和可靠的参考. (三)区域排名要求与较大生成区域相邻的视图得分较高. 实验验证了这种设计. 在对齐对齐内监督精细的函文,同时考虑上下文的相移,可以改善两侧的探测器. 各种发电机的8个标准基准的平衡准确度平均为96.40%,3个内部基准的平衡度平均为93.74%,分别比以往最佳方法高出4.3%和5.9%。 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: • We point out that existing methods underuse the correspondence between aligned data. Image-level methods train the two images independently, and patch-level supervision on mixed views ignores the contextual shift, which makes its per-patch labels imprecise targets. • We propose PRL, which supervises patch responses rather than labels. Relative response supervision reduces the shared contextual component against the same-source patches, reference coherence keeps the reference stable, and area-based ranking adds a view-level constraint. • On eight standard benchmarks of diverse generators and three in-the-wild benchmarks, PRL surpasses the best previous methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy, respectively. It also transfers to the detection of locally manipulated images with no additional training data.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: One family of detectors identifies generated images from the traces left by the generation process, including frequency-domain statistics ( Frank et al., 2020 ; Tan et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Karageorgiou et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ) , pixel-level relations and residuals ( Tan et al., 2024b ; Fu et al., 2025 ) and reconstruction or regeneration error ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Ricker et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Chu et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2026 ) , or from the trace of the camera pipeline that generated images lack ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Another line builds on the pretrained representations of vision foundation models, with light classifiers on frozen features ( Ojha et al., 2023 ; Koutlis and Papadopoulos, 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) or with representation adaptation ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2025b ) ; GAPL ( Qin et al., 2026 ) organizes the feature space with generator-aware prototypes, and others scale the training set to thousands of generators ( Park and Owens, 2025 ) . Both lines are typically trained on real and generated images collected separately.
blocks.zh: 一个探测器家族从生成过程留下的痕迹中识别出生成的图像,包括频率域统计(Frank等,2020年;Tan等,2024年a;Li等,2025年;Karageorgiou等,2025年;Li等,2026年a),像素级关系和残留物. (Tan等,2024b;Fu等,2025)及重建或再生出错(Wang等,2023;Ricker等,2024;Luo等,2024;Yu等,2024;Chu等,2025;Qi等,2026),或出自摄像管中产生图像缺失的痕迹(Wu等,2026). 另一条线路基于对视觉基础模型的预加训练的表述,对冷冻地物的光分解器(Ojha等,2023;Koutlis和Papapapos等,2024;Yang等,2025;或对表示方式进行调整(Liu等,2024;Tan等,2025;Yan等,2025b;GAPL(Qin等,2026;)用发电机-意识原型物组织特征空间,而其他则将培训范围扩大到数千台发电机(Park和Owens,2025)。 两行通常都接受关于分别收集的真实和生成图像的培训。

blocks.en: Separately collected real and generated images differ in content, format and resolution as well as in source, and a detector can separate them by these differences instead of by the traces of generation ( Guillaro et al., 2025 ; Rajan et al., 2025 ) . Alignment removes content shortcut by giving each real image a generated counterpart of matched content. DRCT ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and B-Free ( Guillaro et al., 2025 ) construct generated samples of similar content through reconstruction or regeneration guided by real images; AlignedForensics ( Rajan et al., 2025 ) obtains a tighter spatial correspondence through VAE reconstruction; DDA ( Chen et al., 2025a ) further removes the high-frequency difference and interpolates pixels within each pair. Detectors trained on such pairs generalize better across generators than those trained on separately collected images ( Rajan et al., 2025 ; Guillaro et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . In all of these methods, however, the alignment only shapes the data. The two images of a pair are trained as independent samples with image-level labels, and their correspondence is never used as supervision.
blocks.zh: 单独收集的真实和生成的图像在内容、格式和分辨率以及来源方面各不相同,一个探测器可以通过这些差异而不是生成的痕迹加以区分(Guillaro等,2025;Rajan等,2025)。 对齐会通过给每个真实图像一个匹配内容的生成对应内容来删除内容快捷键. DRCT(Chen等,2024年)和B-Free(Guillaro等,2025年)通过以真实图像为取向的重建或再生,构建出类似内容的样本; AconitionForensics(Rajan等,2025年)通过VAE重建获得更紧密的空间对应; DDA(Chen等,2025年a)进一步去除每对内高频相差并插出像素. 在这种配对方面接受过培训的探测器比在单独收集的图像方面接受过培训的探测器更为普遍(Rajan等,2025;Guillaro等,2025;Chen等,2025a)。 然而,在所有这些方法中,对齐只会塑造数据. 一对的两幅相机被训练成带有图像级别标签的独立标本,而他们的相机从未被用作监制.

blocks.en: Mixing real and generated content yields harder training samples. Without alignment, SimLBR ( Dhakal et al., 2026 ) blends the feature of a real image with that of an unpaired generated image in the latent space of a foundation model and labels the blend as generated, which widens the training distribution but can only carry an image-level label. Within an aligned pair, the pixel-wise interpolation of DDA is again labeled at the image level, whereas PPL ( Yang et al., 2026 ) replaces some real patches by their reconstruction and supervises each patch by its own source. Such a label, however, is decided by that patch alone and ignores the contextual shift. PRL instead compares the same patch across two mixed views and measures its response against the patches whose source is the same in both views.

blocks.en: 3 Method

blocks.en: In this section, we detail PRL, whose framework is shown in Figure 3 . Specifically, PRL supervises a ViT detector with the patch response of an aligned pair: how the score at each patch position changes between two mixed views of the pair. It has two parts: aligned region mixing, which constructs the mixed views, and response learning, which learns the traces of generation from the patch responses. Given a real image and its aligned synthetic image, we mix them patch by patch into two views and train the detector on how each patch score changes between the views.

blocks.en: Table 1 compares PRL with the eleven detectors on the eleven benchmarks. PRL reaches an average balanced accuracy of 95.67 % 95.67\% , surpassing DDA at 89.16 % 89.16\% by 6.5 % 6.5\% and GAPL at 88.93 % 88.93\% by 6.7 % 6.7\% , and is the best method on every benchmark. This consistent margin supports the design of PRL: supervising patch responses against internal references, instead of labeling patches, generalizes across every benchmark. PRL also performs best on Chameleon, the most challenging in-the-wild benchmark, with 90.01 % 90.01\% against 82.41 % 82.41\% for the strongest prior method. The two strongest prior methods fail in different places. GAPL, whose training set spans thousands of generators, stays close to PRL on the standard benchmarks but drops on all three in-the-wild benchmarks, to 69.30 % 69.30\% on Chameleon, and to 79.27 % 79.27\% on DDA-COCO; DDA, the best previous method, is strong on most benchmarks but falls behind on the in-the-wild benchmarks and on the GAN-based ones, with 81.41 % 81.41\% on ForenSynths. Tables 2 and 4 and Appendix D report the detailed results for every subset.

blocks.en: We conduct the ablation on four representative benchmarks: two standard benchmarks, GenImage and AIGCDetect, and two in-the-wild benchmarks, Chameleon and WildRF. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we study patch-level supervision on aligned pairs for AI-generated image detection. Recent methods mix the two images of a pair and label each patch of the mixed view by its source. We find that patches of different sources in a mixed view interact through self-attention, so the feature of each patch also carries information passed from patches of the other source. A per-patch label ignores this contextual shift and is therefore an imprecise target. Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL) instead compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from the change of its score. Source-unchanged patches respond to the shift alone, so PRL measures the source-changed patches against them, keeps each group of them moving as a whole, and ranks the two views by generated area. PRL surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy on eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们研究了对对等对齐的补丁级监督,用于AI生成的图像检测. 近代方法将一对的两幅图像相混合,并按其出处对混合视图的每个补丁进行标签. 我们发现,混合视图中不同来源的补丁通过自觉来相互作用,所以每个补丁的特征也携带从另一个来源的补丁所传递的信息. 每幅标签忽略了这种背景变化,因此是一个不准确的目标. 相对补丁反应学习(PRL)取而代之的是比较一个对齐对齐的两个混合视图的同一块补丁并从其分数变化中学习. source-unchanged satches 单独响应了移位,因此PRL针对它们测量了源被改变的补丁,保持了它们中的每组整体移动,并按生成区域排列了两个视图. 在8个标准基准和3个全局基准中,平均平衡准确度分别超过4.3%和5.9%。

blocks.en: The frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 backbone is adapted with LoRA of rank 8 8 and scaling α = 1 \alpha=1 , applied in every transformer block to the query, key, value and output projections of self-attention and to the two projections of the MLP. The patch scoring head is a single linear layer on the final-layer patch tokens. The detection head is a gating MLP that assigns a weight to every token, aggregates the tokens with the normalized weights and maps the result to the image logit.
blocks.zh: 被冻结的DINOv3 ViT-L/16主干线与8级并缩放α = 1的LORA相适应,适用于每个变压器块的查询,键,值和自意输出预测以及MLP的两个预测. 补丁积分头是最终层补丁符号上的一个单线性地层. 检测头是给每个信使分配一个权重的Gating MLP,将信使与常态权重相加,并将结果映射到图像登录.

blocks.en: At both training and inference, we center-crop every image to 336 × 336 336\times 336 pixels, and we resize an image to the input size instead when both its width and height exceed 1,024 1{,}024 pixels, so that the input covers the whole image. We apply the common augmentations in this field, such as random JPEG compression, Gaussian blur and colour jitter. Each augmentation is drawn once per pair and applied identically to both members, so that the alignment is preserved.
blocks.zh: 在训练与推论中,我们将每个图像都以336×336\times 336像素为中心,当一个图像的宽度和高度都超过1,024 1{,}024像素时,我们将图像的大小调整为输入大小,这样输入就可以覆盖整个图像. 我们在这个领域应用了常见的增强,例如随机的JPEG压缩,高斯模糊和色彩焦躁. 每次加法均一对取出并同样适用于两个成员,以保持对接.

blocks.en: For each training pair, with probability 0.5 0.5 we use the real image with two mixed views, and otherwise the real image with the synthetic image. Each mask replaces one axis-aligned rectangle of patches on the 21 × 21 21\times 21 patch grid of the encoder, so P = 441 P=441 . The two masks of a pair share a base image, the real or the synthetic one with equal probability, and the rectangle takes its patches from the other image. For each mask, we draw the synthetic fraction uniformly from [ 0.1 , 0.9 ] [0.1,0.9] and the aspect ratio of the rectangle log-uniformly from [ 0.5 , 2 ] [0.5,2] , resample until the two fractions differ, and place the rectangle uniformly at random among the positions where it fits.

blocks.en: ( Yan et al., 2025b ) decomposes the weights of the CLIP encoder into orthogonal subspaces by singular value decomposition, freezes the principal subspace to preserve the pretrained knowledge and trains the residual subspace for detection.
blocks.zh: (单位:千美元) Yan等,2025b)以单值分解将CLIP编码器的重量分解为正对子空间,将主子空间冻结以保存被预受训练的知识并训练剩余子空间进行检测.

blocks.en: ( Li et al., 2025 ) feeds the high-frequency components of a discrete wavelet transform to a lightweight ResNet and pairs it with image transformations that preserve the traces of generation: cropping instead of resizing, colour jitter, random rotation and random masking.
blocks.zh: (Li等,2025年)为离散波段变换为轻量级ResNet的高频组件提供饲料,并配以能保存出出产痕迹的图像变换:裁剪取而不用再调整大小,色彩紧张,随机旋转和随机遮掩.

blocks.en: ( Chen et al., 2025a ) aligns generated images with real ones in both the pixel and the frequency domain: VAE reconstruction, high-frequency debias from the real image and pixel mixup.
blocks.zh: (Chen等,2025a.)将生成的图像与像素和频率域中的真实图像对齐: VAE重建,从真实图像和像素相混的高频去比.

blocks.en: ( Qin et al., 2026 ) builds generator-aware prototypes from the principal components of the embeddings of a few generators and fine-tunes the CLIP ViT-L/14 encoder with LoRA so that image embeddings are mapped onto these prototypes. It is trained on the Community Forensics set ( Park and Owens, 2025 ) of several thousand generators.
blocks.zh: (秦等,2026年)从几台发电机嵌入的主要部件中构建出发电机-意识原型,并用LORA对CLIP VIT-L/14编码器进行微调,使图像嵌入到这些原型上. 它接受了数千台发电机的社区法医培训(Park and Owens,2025年)。

blocks.en: Tables 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 and 10 report the per-subset results on GenImage, AIGCDetect, Synthbuster, DRCT-2M, DDA-COCO and EvalGEN, and ForenSynths, which Table 1 and Section 4.2 summarize. PRL is above 98.8 % 98.8\% on every DRCT-2M subset and above 99 % 99\% on every EvalGEN generator; on DDA-COCO its two lowest subsets are the SD3.5 and Flux reconstructions. On ForenSynths, its margin over the alignment-based methods opens on every GAN generator, while the DeepFake, SITD and SAN subsets remain its hardest.
blocks.zh: 表5、表6、表7、表8、表9和表10报告了基因组、AIGC检测、合成器、DDA-COCO和EvalGEN以及ForenSynths的分集结果,表1和第4.2节对此作了概述。 每个DRCT-2M子集的PRL高于98.8% 98.8%;每个EvalGEN生成器高于99%;DDA-CO的最小子集是SD3.5和流量重建。 在ForenSynths上,它相对于基于对齐的方法的比值开启了每个GAN生成器,而DeepFake,SITD和SAN子集仍然是最难的.

blocks.en: Table 11 reports balanced accuracy on the ManipulationBench subset of DailyBench (Section 4.3 ), with the rows of the other detectors, including the detector FPD proposed with the benchmark, as published by DailyBench. Most of the detectors it evaluates stay within a few points of chance on most editors. PRL has the best average, 68.32 % 68.32\% against 66.88 % 66.88\% for DDA and 63.41 % 63.41\% for FPD, and the best result on the three FLUX-based editors, where every other detector except DDA is at chance. DDA is stronger on Qwen-Image-Edit and Step1X-Edit, and SAFE on GPT-Image 2.
